ei.title: The Purpose and Evolution of Egyptian Tomb Art
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: The combination of geometrical regularity and keen observation of nature is characteristic of all Egyptian art. We can study it best in the reliefs and paintings that adorned the walls of the tombs. The word 'adorned', it is true, may hardly fit an art which was meant to be seen by no one but the dead man's soul. In fact, these works were not intended to be enjoyed. They were meant to 'keep alive'. Once, in a dark distant past, it had been the custom when a powerful man died to let his servants and slaves accompany him into the grave so that he should arrive in the beyond with a suitable suite. They were sacrificed. Later, these horrors were considered either too cruel or too costly, and art came to the rescue. Instead of real servants, the great ones of this earth were given images as substitutes. The pictures and models found in Egyptian tombs were connected with the idea of providing the souls with helpmates in the other world.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② adorning → adorned: 관계절 능동 과거동사
det.analysis:

② adorning: the reliefs and paintings that adorned → 관계절 주어가 능동으로 '장식했다'이므로 과거형 adorned 필요. adorning(현재분사)은 틀림 ←정답

④ providing: the idea of providing → 전치사 of + 동명사 → 적절
det.tip: 관계절 동사: 주어가 무덤 벽을 '장식한' 능동 과거 → adorned / adorning(현재분사) 오류

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ was → had been: 먼 과거부터 이어온 관습 → 과거완료 필요
det.analysis:
① keen: keen observation → 형용사로 명사 수식 → 적절

② meant: was meant to 'keep alive' → be meant to = ~하기 위한 것이다 → 적절

③ to be seen: was meant to be seen → be + p.p. 수동 → 적절

④ was: it had been the custom → 과거 어느 시점 이전부터 계속된 관습이므로 과거완료(had been) 필요. 단순과거 was는 틀림 ←정답
det.tip: it had been the custom: 먼 과거부터 이어온 관습 → 과거완료 / 단순과거 was는 오류

det.korean: ③ should arrived → should arrive: 조동사 뒤 동사원형 필수
det.analysis:
① to let: it had been the custom ... to let → to부정사 관용 구문 → 적절

② accompany: let + servants and slaves + accompany → 사역동사 목적보어 원형부정사 → 적절

③ should arrived: so that he should arrive → 조동사(should) 뒤에는 동사원형. arrived(과거형)는 틀림 ←정답

④ found: The pictures and models found in Egyptian tombs → 과거분사 후치수식(발견된) → 적절
det.tip: 조동사(should/will/can 등) + 동사원형 필수 / should arrived → should arrive

det.korean: ③ exclusive → characteristic: '특징적이다'가 맞음, '독점적이다'는 부적절
det.analysis:
① geometrical: 기하학적 규칙성 → 이집트 예술의 특성으로 적절

② keen: 예리한 자연 관찰 → 적절

③ exclusive: '모든 이집트 예술에 독점적이다' → 문맥상 characteristic(특징적이다)이 맞음. exclusive는 '다른 것을 배제한다'는 의미로 부적절 ←정답

④ adorned: reliefs and paintings that adorned the walls → 장식했다 → 적절
det.tip: characteristic of = ~의 특징이다 / exclusive = 배타적인, 독점적인 → 전혀 다른 의미

questions.passage: The combination of geometrical regularity and keen observation of nature is characteristic of all Egyptian art. We can study it best in the reliefs and paintings that adorned the walls of the tombs. The word 'adorned', it is true, may hardly fit an art which was meant to be seen by no one but the dead man's soul. In fact, these works were not intended to be enjoyed. They were meant to 'keep alive'. Once, in a dark distant past, it had been the custom when a powerful man died to let his servants and slaves accompany him into the grave so that he should arrive in the beyond with a suitable suite. They were sacrificed. Later, these horrors were considered either too cruel or too costly, and art came to the rescue. Instead of real servants, the great ones of this earth were given images as substitutes. The pictures and models found in Egyptian tombs were connected with the idea of providing the souls with helpmates in the other world.
